Slack Open Direct Conversation

Open or resume a direct conversation for 1–8 comma-separated user IDs. Exclude the calling bot/user; Slack adds it. The channel item can feed its ID to Post Message. May create a new conversation; it does not send a message. Existing membership normally resolves to the existing conversation.

POST /api/conversations.open. External write: enable confirmWrites explicitly; $retries must be 0. Acceptance is not successful job completion. Reconcile uncertain completion before retrying.

Inputs: users (required). Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, item. The item uses an exact named structural contract and paired field codecs. Unknown provider fields and permitted nulls are retained.

Setup: baseUrl defaults to https://slack.com. Resolve credentials via encrypted secret name SLACK_BOT_TOKEN or the selected connection profile; never put tokens in literal node inputs or log them. Required access: im:write for a DM or mpim:write for a multi-person DM, plus visibility of each user. Request timeout defaults to 15000ms (100..120000); request and response limit defaults to 1 MiB (1024..3000000 bytes). HTTPS is required; explicitly permitted private HTTP is available for self-hosted servers. Redirects are rejected. No implicit retries, pagination, polling or provider calls on installation. Errors omit raw bodies and credentials. The next control output is the normal completion route; failures throw through On error.

ingressRequirements.name: Slack verified relay
ingressRequirements.description: Independently deployed Slack verifier forwards canonical authenticated HTTPS events.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Verify X-Slack-Signature as v0=hex(HMAC-SHA256(signingSecret, "v0:" + X-Slack-Request-Timestamp + ":" + exactRawBody)); reject timestamps over five minutes from relay time using constant-time comparison.
Handle verified url_verification JSON challenges at the relay, return the challenge response, and acknowledge verified event_callback requests within Slack limits.

Forward only event_callback payloads; use event.type as envelope eventType, event_id as deliveryId and event_time converted from Unix seconds to a UTC ISO8601 string as occurredAt. Subscribe required scopes in the Slack app.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-relay"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
